dedupe_keys.name: evcivil event camera civil infrastructure defect dataset

description: evCIVIL provides event-camera recordings for visible defect detection in civil infrastructure. The research team publishes synchronized asynchronous event streams and greyscale images from a DAVIS346 camera, with labels for cracks and spalling. Field observations comprise 318 sequences covering about 80 minutes and 458 distinct cracks plus 121 spalling instances. Laboratory observations contain 362 sequences with 220 cracks and 308 spalling instances. The source describes roads, buildings, pavements and tunnels under varied lighting and weather; acquisition countries and calendar dates are not established in the inspected landing metadata. Events and frames use separate HDF5 files, while bounding-box categories use NumPy files. DTU Data provides public field and laboratory archives free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that controlled laboratory cases and field cases have different conditions, and visual labels are not structural failure probabilities. Simulation uses include evaluating inspection sensing and deriving condition observations for maintenance models. No related catalogue resource was established as a direct dependency. The January 2026 archived release was identified through its metadata, but recordings and label files were not downloaded or evaluated.
name: evCIVIL event-camera civil infrastructure defect dataset
